/* ============================================================
   NVDA SENTIMENT DATA WAREHOUSE
   Dedicated SQL Pool: sqlNVDA
   ============================================================ */


/* ============================================================
   1. DIM DATE
   Grain: one row per calendar date
   ============================================================ */

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.DimDate', 'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE dbo.DimDate
    (
        DateKey         INT          NOT NULL,
        FullDate        DATE         NOT NULL,
        CalendarYear    INT          NOT NULL,
        CalendarMonth   INT          NOT NULL,
        MonthName       VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
        DayOfMonth      INT          NOT NULL,
        DayOfWeekNumber INT          NOT NULL,
        DayName         VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
        YearMonth       VARCHAR(7)   NOT NULL
    )
    WITH
    (
        HEAP,
        DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE
    );
END;
GO


/* ============================================================
   2. DIM USER
   Grain: one row per X/Twitter user
   ============================================================ */

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.DimUser', 'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE dbo.DimUser
    (
        UserKey             BIGINT       NOT NULL,
        UserID              VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
        IsBlueVerified      BIT,
        AccountCreatedAt    DATE,
        AccountAgeDays      INT,
        IsNewAccount        BIT,
        IsInfluencer        BIT,
        FollowersCount      BIGINT,
        FriendsCount        BIGINT,
        MediaCount          BIGINT,
        CredibilityScore    FLOAT
    )
    WITH
    (
        HEAP,
        DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE
    );
END;
GO


/* ============================================================
   3. FACT DAILY TWEET
   Grain: one row per day
   ============================================================ */

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.FactDailyTweet', 'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE dbo.FactDailyTweet
    (
        DateKey                 INT NOT NULL,
        TotalTweets             BIGINT,
        AvgSentiment            FLOAT,
        AvgInteractionScore     FLOAT,
        AvgFavoriteRatio        FLOAT,
        AvgReplyRatio           FLOAT,
        TotalViralTweet         BIGINT,
        AvgCredibilityScore     FLOAT,
        AvgFollowers            FLOAT
    )
    WITH
    (
        HEAP,
        DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN
    );
END;
GO


/* ============================================================
   4. FACT MARKET SUMMARY PER DAY
   Grain: one row per market date
   ============================================================ */

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.FactMarketSummaryPerDay', 'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE dbo.FactMarketSummaryPerDay
    (
        DateKey                 INT NOT NULL,
        CurrentOpen             FLOAT,
        CurrentClose            FLOAT,
        CurrentHigh             FLOAT,
        CurrentLow              FLOAT,
        CurrentVolume           FLOAT,
        ActualNextVolume        FLOAT,
        AvgSentiment            FLOAT,
        TweetCount              BIGINT,
        PredictedNextVolume     FLOAT,
        PredictionAccuracy      FLOAT
    )
    WITH
    (
        HEAP,
        DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN
    );
END;
GO


/* ============================================================
   5. FACT VIRAL TWEET LOG
   Grain: one row per viral tweet
   ============================================================ */

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.FactViralTweetLog', 'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE dbo.FactViralTweetLog
    (
        TweetID             VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
        DateKey             INT          NOT NULL,
        UserKey             BIGINT       NOT NULL,
        FullText            VARCHAR(4000),
        SentimentScore      FLOAT,
        InteractionScore    FLOAT,

        FavoriteCount       BIGINT,
        RetweetCount        BIGINT,
        ReplyCount          BIGINT,
        ViewCount           BIGINT,
        CredibilityScore    FLOAT

    WITH
    (
        HEAP,
        DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN
    );

GO


/* ============================================================
   6. FACT USER TYPE DISTRIBUTION
   Grain: one row per day
   ============================================================ */

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.FactUserTypeDistribution', 'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE dbo.FactUserTypeDistribution
    (
        DateKey                       INT NOT NULL,
        InfluencerTweetCount          BIGINT,
        NewAccountTweetCount          BIGINT,

    )

/* ============================================================

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.FactTopUsersByTweetCount', 'U') IS NULL

    WITH

    );

PRINT 'Dimensional warehouse tables created successfully.';
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_DailyRefresh
AS
BEGIN

    /* =========================================================
       1. CLEAR WAREHOUSE
       ========================================================= */

    TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.FactViralTweetLog;
    TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.FactDailyTweet;
    TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.FactMarketSummaryPerDay;
    TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.FactUserTypeDistribution;
    TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.FactTopUsersByTweetCount;
    TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.FactTopUsersByViralTweets;
    TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.FactInfluencerMonthlyEngagement;
    TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.FactPrediction;

    TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.DimUser;
    TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.DimDate;


    /* =========================================================
       2. DIM DATE
       Conformed date dimension
       ========================================================= */

    INSERT INTO dbo.DimDate
    (
        DateKey,
        FullDate,
        CalendarYear,
        CalendarMonth,
        MonthName,
        DayOfMonth,
        DayOfWeekNumber,
        DayName,
        YearMonth
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        YEAR(d) * 10000 + MONTH(d) * 100 + DAY(d) AS DateKey,
        d AS FullDate,
        YEAR(d) AS CalendarYear,
        MONTH(d) AS CalendarMonth,
        DATENAME(MONTH, d) AS MonthName,
        DAY(d) AS DayOfMonth,
        DATEPART(WEEKDAY, d) AS DayOfWeekNumber,
        DATENAME(WEEKDAY, d) AS DayName,
        CONCAT(
            YEAR(d),
            '-',
            RIGHT('0' + CAST(MONTH(d) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2)
        ) AS YearMonth
    FROM
    (
        SELECT tweet_created_at_date AS d
        FROM dbo.ext_DailyTweetSummary

        UNION

        SELECT tweet_created_at_date
        FROM dbo.ext_MarketSummaryPerDay

        UNION

        SELECT tweet_created_at_date
        FROM dbo.ext_ViralTweetLog

        UNION

        SELECT tweet_created_at_date
        FROM dbo.ext_UserTypeDistributionPerDay

        UNION

        SELECT year_month
        FROM dbo.ext_InfluencerMonthlyEngagement

        UNION

        SELECT prediction_date
        FROM dbo.ext_PredictionHistory

        UNION

        SELECT target_date
        FROM dbo.ext_PredictionHistory
    ) dates
    WHERE d IS NOT NULL;


    /* =========================================================
       3. DIM USER
       Natural key: UserID
       Surrogate key: UserKey
       ========================================================= */

    INSERT INTO dbo.DimUser
    (
        UserKey,
        UserID,
        IsBlueVerified,
        AccountCreatedAt,
        AccountAgeDays,
        IsNewAccount,
        IsInfluencer,
        FollowersCount,
        FriendsCount,
        MediaCount,
        CredibilityScore
    )
    SELECT
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY user_id) AS UserKey,
        user_id,
        is_blue_verified,
        account_created_at,
        account_age_days,
        is_new_account,
        is_influencer,
        followers_count,
        friends_count,
        media_count,
        credibility_score
    FROM dbo.ext_UserProfile;


    /* =========================================================
       4. FACT DAILY TWEET
       Grain: 1 row / date
       ========================================================= */

    INSERT INTO dbo.FactDailyTweet
    (
        DateKey,
        TotalTweets,
        AvgSentiment,
        AvgInteractionScore,
        AvgFavoriteRatio,
        AvgReplyRatio,
        TotalViralTweet,
        AvgCredibilityScore,
        AvgFollowers
    )
    SELECT
        YEAR(tweet_created_at_date) * 10000
            + MONTH(tweet_created_at_date) * 100
            + DAY(tweet_created_at_date),

        total_tweets,
        avg_sentiment,
        avg_interaction_score,
        avg_favorite_ratio,
        avg_reply_ratio,
        total_viral_tweet,
        avg_credibility_score,
        avg_followers

    FROM dbo.ext_DailyTweetSummary
    WHERE tweet_created_at_date IS NOT NULL;


    /* =========================================================
       5. FACT MARKET SUMMARY
       Grain: 1 row / market date
       ========================================================= */

    INSERT INTO dbo.FactMarketSummaryPerDay
    (
        DateKey,
        CurrentOpen,
        CurrentClose,
        CurrentHigh,
        CurrentLow,
        CurrentVolume,
        ActualNextVolume,
        AvgSentiment,
        TweetCount,
        PredictedNextVolume,
        PredictionAccuracy
    )
    SELECT
        YEAR(tweet_created_at_date) * 10000
            + MONTH(tweet_created_at_date) * 100
            + DAY(tweet_created_at_date),

        current_open,
        current_close,
        current_high,
        current_low,
        current_volume,
        actual_volume,
        avg_sentiment,
        tweet_count,
        predicted_volume,
        prediction_accuracy

    FROM dbo.ext_MarketSummaryPerDay
    WHERE tweet_created_at_date IS NOT NULL;


    /* =========================================================
       6. FACT VIRAL TWEET LOG
       Resolve UserID -> UserKey
       ========================================================= */

    INSERT INTO dbo.FactViralTweetLog
    (
        TweetID,
        DateKey,
        UserKey,
        FullText,
        SentimentScore,
        InteractionScore,
        FollowersCount,
        FavoriteCount,
        RetweetCount,
        ReplyCount,
        ViewCount,
        CredibilityScore
    )
    SELECT
        v.tweet_id,

        YEAR(v.tweet_created_at_date) * 10000
            + MONTH(v.tweet_created_at_date) * 100
            + DAY(v.tweet_created_at_date),

        u.UserKey,
        v.full_text,
        v.sentiment_score,
        v.interaction_score,
        v.followers_count,
        v.favorite_count,
        v.retweet_count,
        v.reply_count,
        v.view_count,
        v.credibility_score

    FROM dbo.ext_ViralTweetLog v

    INNER JOIN dbo.DimUser u
        ON v.user_id = u.UserID

    WHERE v.tweet_created_at_date IS NOT NULL;


    /* =========================================================
       7. FACT USER TYPE DISTRIBUTION
       Grain: 1 row / date
       ========================================================= */

    INSERT INTO dbo.FactUserTypeDistribution
    (
        DateKey,
        InfluencerTweetCount,
        NewAccountTweetCount,
        BlueVerifiedTweetCount,
        TotalTweets,
        DistinctUsers,
        AvgAccountAge,
        GeneralPublicTweetCount,
        EstablishedAccountTweetCount,
        UnverifiedTweetCount
    )
    SELECT
        YEAR(tweet_created_at_date) * 10000
            + MONTH(tweet_created_at_date) * 100
            + DAY(tweet_created_at_date),

        influencer_tweet_count,
        new_account_tweet_count,
        blue_verified_tweet_count,
        total_tweets,
        distinct_users,
        avg_account_age,
        general_public_tweet_count,
        established_account_tweet_count,
        unverified_tweet_count

    FROM dbo.ext_UserTypeDistributionPerDay
    WHERE tweet_created_at_date IS NOT NULL;


    /* =========================================================
       8. TOP USERS BY TWEET COUNT
       ========================================================= */

    INSERT INTO dbo.FactTopUsersByTweetCount
    (
        UserKey,
        TweetCount,
        FollowersCount,
        CredibilityScore,
        IsInfluencer
    )
    SELECT
        u.UserKey,
        e.tweet_count,
        e.followers_count,
        e.credibility_score,
        e.is_influencer

    FROM dbo.ext_TopUsersByTweetCount e

    INNER JOIN dbo.DimUser u
        ON e.user_id = u.UserID;


    /* =========================================================
       9. TOP USERS BY VIRAL TWEETS
       ========================================================= */

    INSERT INTO dbo.FactTopUsersByViralTweets
    (
        UserKey,
        ViralTweetCount,
        AvgInteractionScore,
        FollowersCount,
        CredibilityScore
    )
    SELECT
        u.UserKey,
        e.viral_tweet_count,
        e.avg_interaction_score,
        e.followers_count,
        e.credibility_score

    FROM dbo.ext_TopUsersByViralTweets e

    INNER JOIN dbo.DimUser u
        ON e.user_id = u.UserID;


    /* =========================================================
       10. INFLUENCER MONTHLY ENGAGEMENT
       Grain: 1 row / month
       ========================================================= */

    INSERT INTO dbo.FactInfluencerMonthlyEngagement
    (
        MonthDateKey,
        CalendarYear,
        CalendarMonth,
        InfluencerTweetCount,
        AvgSentimentScore,
        AvgInteraction,
        DistinctInfluencers,
        TotalFavorites,
        TotalRetweets,
        TotalReplies
    )
    SELECT
        YEAR(year_month) * 10000
            + MONTH(year_month) * 100
            + 1,

        year,
        month,
        influencer_tweet_count,
        avg_sentiment_score,
        avg_interaction,
        distinct_influencers,
        total_favorites,
        total_retweets,
        total_replies

    FROM dbo.ext_InfluencerMonthlyEngagement
    WHERE year_month IS NOT NULL;

    /* =========================================================
   11. FACT PREDICTION
   Grain: one row per prediction session / target
   ========================================================= */

    INSERT INTO dbo.FactPrediction
    (
        PredictionDateKey,
        TargetDateKey,
        PredictedVolume,
        ActualVolume,
        PredictionAccuracy,
        EvaluationStatus,
        ModelVersion,
        PredictionGeneratedAtUTC,
        TweetCount,
        AvgSentimentScore,
        AvgInteractionScore
    )
    SELECT
        (
            YEAR(prediction_date) * 10000
            + MONTH(prediction_date) * 100
            + DAY(prediction_date)
        ) AS PredictionDateKey,

        CASE
            WHEN target_date IS NOT NULL
            THEN (
                YEAR(target_date) * 10000
                + MONTH(target_date) * 100
                + DAY(target_date)
            )
            ELSE NULL
        END AS TargetDateKey,

        predicted_volume,
        actual_volume,
        prediction_accuracy,
        evaluation_status,
        model_version,
        prediction_generated_at_utc,
        tweet_count,
        avg_sentiment_score,
        avg_interaction_score

    FROM dbo.ext_PredictionHistory
    WHERE prediction_date IS NOT NULL
    ;

END;
GO

SELECT
    s.name AS schema_name,
    t.name AS external_table
FROM sys.external_tables t
JOIN sys.schemas s
    ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id
ORDER BY t.name;

EXEC dbo.sp_DailyRefresh;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS DimDate_Count
FROM dbo.DimDate;
GO

SELECT COUNT(*) AS DimUser_Count
FROM dbo.DimUser;
GO

SELECT COUNT(*) AS FactDailyTweet_Count
FROM dbo.FactDailyTweet;
GO

SELECT COUNT(*) AS FactMarketSummaryPerDay_Count

GO

SELECT COUNT(*) AS FactViralTweetLog_Count
FROM dbo.FactViralTweetLog;
GO

SELECT COUNT(*) AS FactUserTypeDistribution_Count
FROM dbo.FactUserTypeDistribution;
GO

SELECT COUNT(*) AS FactTopUsersByTweetCount_Count
FROM dbo.FactTopUsersByTweetCount;
GO

SELECT COUNT(*) AS FactTopUsersByViralTweets_Count
FROM dbo.FactTopUsersByViralTweets;
GO

SELECT COUNT(*) AS FactInfluencerMonthlyEngagement_Count
FROM dbo.FactInfluencerMonthlyEngagement;
GO

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

import yfinance as yf
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.ml import PipelineModel

ET = ZoneInfo("America/New_York")

STORAGE_ACCOUNT = "stnvdaanna2026"

HISTORICAL_GOLD_PATH = (
    f"abfss://gold@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    "tweets_stock/historical/"
)

MODEL_PATH = (
    f"abfss://gold@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    "models/nvda_volume_rf/"
)

PREDICTION_ROOT = (
    f"abfss://gold@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    "prediction/streaming/"
)

print("Historical Gold:", HISTORICAL_GOLD_PATH)
print("Model:", MODEL_PATH)
print("Prediction:", PREDICTION_ROOT)

# Market data is fetched below for all outstanding labels.
# Do not gate scheduled runs on a hard-coded diagnostic date.
# Actual volumes are keyed by target market date in ground_truth_df.

historical_gold_df = spark.read.parquet(
    HISTORICAL_GOLD_PATH
)

print("Historical rows:", historical_gold_df.count())

historical_gold_df.select(
    "prediction_session_date",
    "next_trading_date",
    "next_available_volume"
).orderBy(
    F.col("prediction_session_date").desc()
).show(30, truncate=False)

(
    historical_gold_df
    .groupBy(
        "prediction_session_date",
        "next_trading_date"
    )
    .agg(
        F.first("next_available_volume").alias("actual_next_volume"),
        F.count("*").alias("tweet_count")
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("prediction_session_date").desc()
    )
    .show(30, truncate=False)

import pandas as pd

# Only include today's bar after the evening backfill cutoff in Eastern time.
# Yahoo's end date is exclusive. Extend the range for older unresolved labels.
now_et = datetime.now(ET)
end_date = now_et.date() + timedelta(days=1 if now_et.hour >= 18 else 0)
oldest_target = (
    historical_gold_df
    .filter(F.col("next_available_volume").isNull())
    .agg(F.min(F.to_date("next_trading_date")).alias("target"))
    .first()["target"]
)
start_date = min(now_et.date() - timedelta(days=30), oldest_target) if oldest_target else now_et.date() - timedelta(days=30)

stock_pdf = yf.download(
    "NVDA", start=start_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
    end=end_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), auto_adjust=False, progress=False
)
if isinstance(stock_pdf.columns, pd.MultiIndex):
    stock_pdf.columns = stock_pdf.columns.get_level_values(0)
stock_pdf = stock_pdf.reset_index()

# Missing, zero, and negative volumes are not completed trading-session labels.
stock_lookup = {
    row["Date"].strftime("%Y-%m-%d"): int(row["Volume"])
    for _, row in stock_pdf.iterrows()
    if pd.notna(row["Volume"]) and row["Volume"] > 0
    and row["Date"].date() < end_date
}
print("Available completed market dates:", sorted(stock_lookup))

unresolved_sessions_df = (
    historical_gold_df
    .filter(
        F.col("next_available_volume").isNull()
    )
    .select(
        "prediction_session_date",
        "next_trading_date"
    )
    .distinct()
    .orderBy("prediction_session_date")
)

display(unresolved_sessions_df)

from pyspark.sql.types import StructType, StructField, DateType, LongType
from datetime import datetime

ground_truth_rows = [
    (
        datetime.strptime(date, "%Y-%m-%d").date(),
        volume
    )
    for date, volume in stock_lookup.items()
]

ground_truth_schema = StructType([
    StructField("market_date", DateType(), False),
    StructField("actual_volume", LongType(), False)
])

ground_truth_df = spark.createDataFrame(
    ground_truth_rows,
    ground_truth_schema
)

display(
    ground_truth_df.orderBy(
        F.col("market_date").desc()
    )

backfillable_sessions_df = (
    unresolved_sessions_df
    .join(
        ground_truth_df,
        unresolved_sessions_df["next_trading_date"]
        == ground_truth_df["market_date"],
        "inner"
    )
    .select(
        "prediction_session_date",
        "next_trading_date",
        "actual_volume"
    )
)

display(backfillable_sessions_df)

backfill_count = backfillable_sessions_df.count()

print("Backfillable sessions:", backfill_count)

if backfill_count == 0:
    print("No completed ground truth is available.")
    print("Historical Gold remains unchanged.")
    print("Model remains unchanged.")
else:
    display(backfillable_sessions_df)

if backfill_count > 0:

    labels_df = (
        backfillable_sessions_df
        .select(
            F.col("next_trading_date"),
            F.col("actual_volume")
                .cast("long")
                .alias("backfilled_volume")
        )
        .dropDuplicates(["next_trading_date"])
    )

    updated_gold_df = (
        historical_gold_df
        .join(
            labels_df,
            on="next_trading_date",
            how="left"
        )
        .withColumn(
            "next_available_volume",
            F.coalesce(
                F.col("next_available_volume"),
                F.col("backfilled_volume")
            )
        )
        .drop("backfilled_volume")
    )

    print(
        "Remaining unlabeled rows:",
        updated_gold_df
        .filter(
            F.col("next_available_volume").isNull()
        )
        .count()

prediction_archive_df = (
    spark.read
    .option("recursiveFileLookup", "true")
    .parquet(PREDICTION_ROOT)
)

prediction_archive_df.select(
    "prediction_session_date",
    "predicted_next_volume",
    "tweet_count",
    "model_version",
    "prediction_generated_at_utc"
).show(truncate=False)

session_target_df = (
    historical_gold_df
    .select(
        "prediction_session_date",
        "next_trading_date"
    )
    .distinct()
)

prediction_with_target_df = (
    prediction_archive_df.alias("p")
    .join(
        session_target_df.alias("s"),
        on="prediction_session_date",
        how="left"
    )
)

prediction_with_target_df.select(
    "prediction_session_date",
    "next_trading_date",
    "predicted_next_volume",
    "tweet_count"
).show(truncate=False)

evaluated_predictions_df = (
    prediction_with_target_df.alias("p")
    .join(
        ground_truth_df.alias("g"),
        F.col("p.next_trading_date")
        == F.col("g.market_date"),
        "inner"
    )
    .withColumn(
        "absolute_error",
        F.abs(
            F.col("actual_volume")
            - F.col("predicted_next_volume")
        )
    )
    .withColumn(
        "relative_error",
        F.col("absolute_error")
        / F.col("actual_volume")
    )
    .withColumn(
        "prediction_accuracy",
        F.lit(1.0)
        - F.col("relative_error")
    )

evaluated_predictions_df.select(
    "prediction_session_date",
    "next_trading_date",
    F.round(
        "predicted_next_volume", 0
    ).alias("predicted_volume"),
    "actual_volume",
    F.round(
        "absolute_error", 0
    ).alias("absolute_error"),
    F.round(
        "relative_error", 4
    ).alias("relative_error"),
    F.round(
        "prediction_accuracy", 4

def merge_daily_tweets(historical, envelopes):
    """BI-only merge: preserve real tweet time and historical ML labels."""
    if "tweets" not in envelopes.columns:
        raise ValueError("Stream archive is missing the tweets array")
    # No inferred element schema when every archived response has an empty array.
    if not hasattr(envelopes.schema["tweets"].dataType.elementType, "fields"):
        if envelopes.filter(F.size("tweets") > 0).limit(1).count():
            raise ValueError("Stream tweets must be JSON objects")
        return historical
    source_file = F.col("_source_file") if "_source_file" in envelopes.columns else F.lit("")
    stream = envelopes.select(
        F.to_timestamp("generated_at_utc").alias("_observed_at"),
        source_file.alias("_source_file"), F.explode("tweets").alias("tweet")
    ).select("tweet.*", "_observed_at", "_source_file")
    required = {"tweet_id", "user_id", "tweet_timestamp_utc"}
    if not required.issubset(stream.columns):
        raise ValueError("Stream tweet is missing identity or UTC timestamp fields")
    stream = (stream.withColumn("tweet_timestamp_utc", F.to_timestamp("tweet_timestamp_utc"))
              .withColumn("tweet_timestamp_et", F.from_utc_timestamp("tweet_timestamp_utc", "America/New_York")))
    if stream.filter(F.col("tweet_timestamp_utc").isNull() | F.col("tweet_id").isNull()
                     | (F.trim("tweet_id") == "") | F.col("user_id").isNull()
                     | (F.trim("user_id") == "")).limit(1).count():
        raise ValueError("Invalid stream tweet identity or timestamp; aggregates unchanged")
    # Overlapping collection windows and reruns must not count a tweet twice.
    stream = (stream.withColumn("_rn", F.row_number().over(
        Window.partitionBy("tweet_id").orderBy(F.col("_observed_at").desc_nulls_last(),
                                               F.col("_source_file").desc())))
        .filter(F.col("_rn") == 1).drop("_rn"))
    # Ingestion's candidate session is not a tweet date or an authoritative ML label.
    protected = {"prediction_session_date", "next_trading_date", "next_available_volume",
                 "current_open", "current_close", "current_high", "current_low", "current_volume"}
    stream = stream.select(*[
        (F.col(field.name) if field.name in stream.columns and field.name not in protected
         else F.lit(None)).cast(field.dataType).alias(field.name)
        for field in historical.schema.fields
    ])
    merged = historical.alias("h").join(stream.alias("s"), on="tweet_id", how="full")
    return merged.select(F.col("tweet_id"), *[
        F.coalesce(F.col("s." + c), F.col("h." + c)).alias(c)
        for c in historical.columns if c != "tweet_id"
    ])


def completed_market_frame(stock_pdf, end_date):
    """One completed Yahoo bar per market date; end_date is exclusive."""
    import pandas as pd
    import math
    pdf = stock_pdf.copy()
    if isinstance(pdf.columns, pd.MultiIndex):
        pdf.columns = pdf.columns.get_level_values(0)
    pdf = pdf.reset_index()
    fields = ["Open", "Close", "High", "Low", "Volume"]
    if not {"Date", *fields}.issubset(pdf.columns):
        raise ValueError("Yahoo market response is missing OHLCV columns")
    rows = []
    for _, row in pdf.iterrows():
        market_date = pd.Timestamp(row["Date"]).date()
        values = [float(row[c]) for c in fields]
        if market_date < end_date and all(math.isfinite(v) and v > 0 for v in values):
            rows.append((market_date, *values))
    if not rows:
        raise ValueError("No completed market bars; refusing to overwrite market aggregates")
    schema = StructType([StructField("tweet_created_at_date", DateType(), False)] + [
        StructField("current_" + c.lower(), DoubleType(), False) for c in fields
    ])
    return spark.createDataFrame(rows, schema).dropDuplicates(["tweet_created_at_date"])


def build_market_summary(tweets, market, historical, predictions):
    """Calendar-date OHLCV is independent of tweet coverage; forecast uses session D."""
    sentiment = tweets.groupBy("tweet_created_at_date").agg(
        F.avg("sentiment_score").alias("avg_sentiment"), F.count("*").alias("tweet_count"))
    summary = market.join(sentiment, on="tweet_created_at_date", how="full")
    # The forecast made in session D and its next-session actual belong together.
    # Do not join a forecast on target D while using the label for D+1.
    labels = (historical.groupBy("prediction_session_date")
              .agg(F.max("next_available_volume").cast("double").alias("actual_volume"))
              .withColumnRenamed("prediction_session_date", "tweet_created_at_date"))
    summary = summary.join(labels, on="tweet_created_at_date", how="left")
    if predictions is not None:
        latest = (predictions.withColumn("tweet_created_at_date", F.to_date("prediction_session_date"))
                  .withColumn("_rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("tweet_created_at_date")
                              .orderBy(F.col("prediction_generated_at_utc").desc())))
                  .filter(F.col("_rn") == 1)
                  .select("tweet_created_at_date", F.col("predicted_next_volume").cast("double").alias("predicted_volume")))
        summary = summary.join(latest, on="tweet_created_at_date", how="left")
    else:
        summary = summary.withColumn("predicted_volume", F.lit(None).cast("double"))
    return (summary.withColumn("tweet_count", F.coalesce("tweet_count", F.lit(0).cast("long")))
            .withColumn("prediction_accuracy", F.when(
                (F.col("actual_volume") > 0) & F.col("predicted_volume").isNotNull(),
                1 - F.abs(F.col("actual_volume") - F.col("predicted_volume")) / F.col("actual_volume")))
            .select("tweet_created_at_date", "current_open", "current_close", "current_high", "current_low",
                    "current_volume", "actual_volume", "avg_sentiment", "tweet_count", "predicted_volume", "prediction_accuracy"))

# Mapping and labels have different grains. A session resolves a target date;

    historical_gold.select(

        .filter(F.col("count") > 1).limit(1).count()):
    raise ValueError("Historical Gold has multiple target dates for a prediction session.")

# next_available_volume is the label for next_trading_date, NOT the current
# prediction_session_date. current_volume is not the next-session actual.
target_labels = (
    historical_gold.select(
        F.to_date("next_trading_date").alias("target_date"),
        F.col("next_available_volume").cast("double").alias("actual_volume")
    )
    .filter(F.col("target_date").isNotNull()
            & (F.col("actual_volume") > 0)
            & ~F.isnan("actual_volume")
            & (F.col("actual_volume") < F.lit(float("inf"))))
    .groupBy("target_date")
    .agg(F.max("actual_volume").alias("actual_volume"),
         F.countDistinct("actual_volume").alias("_label_count"))
)

    raise ValueError("Historical Gold has conflicting actual volumes for a target date.")
